title: PclGPT: A Large Language Model for Patronizing and Condescending Language Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance in detecting Patronizing and Condescending Language (PCL) directed at socioeconomic groups such as poor families, homeless, and in-need individuals.
Comparing PCL detection performance for statements targeting migrants, immigrants, and refugees to identify disparities in the model's sensitivity.
Measuring the model's accuracy and fairness in detecting PCL targeted towards disabled individuals as part of a vulnerable group detection evaluation.
Evaluating model performance in detecting PCL directed at women to assess demographic disparities in implicit toxic language detection.
Analyzing model detection capabilities and building datasets for PCL directed at specific age demographics, including children and the elderly.
Assessing the model's ability to identify implicit toxicity and condescending language directed at single-parent families.
